Initial release of 医疗器械召回级别判定器 (recall-decision-checker):

- Provides rule-based recall grade decision support for medical devices based on official regulations.
- Outputs results in JSON IR format, covering the TH-MED-003 domain (medical device lifecycle).
- Designed as a zero-dependency tool with command-line usage for ease of integration.
- Includes compliance disclaimers; results are for decision support only and must be verified against official texts.
- Error codes indicate outcome status and input sufficiency.
- Documentation includes usage instructions, theory background, and tool family references.
